comparability_rules: Run single-process against the local in-process TestClient.
Use the same scenario, seed, sample count, and step interval before comparing runtime implementations.
Treat generated_at and latency values as run-specific; workload, targets, and contract fields are stable.
A Rust data-plane candidate should emit this report shape, including gap-to-target values, before replacing a Python hot path.
Keep execution_profile fields explicit so future Rust results are not compared against a different client/process/load shape.
Preserve resource_guard fields so future runs stay comparable and inside the local automation safety envelope.

measurement_method.alert_latency: elapsed wall-clock time around manual fault POST requests, summarized as nearest-rank p95
measurement_method.dropped_events: expected telemetry query rows minus bounded replay sample count, floored at zero
measurement_method.replay_latency: elapsed wall-clock time around bounded replay GET requests, summarized as nearest-rank p95
measurement_method.sample_rate: catalog channel count multiplied by 1 / step_seconds

benchmark_contract.purpose: Comparable baseline contract for the current Python/FastAPI control-plane path and future narrow Rust data-plane hot paths.

workload_generation.database: fresh local SQLite database unless --database is provided
workload_generation.source: Stage 02 telemetry channel catalog via the FastAPI simulation endpoint

compatibility_requirements: Use the same workload scenario, seed, sample count, and step interval.
Keep execution_profile and resource_guard visible in every report.
Report dropped_event_count explicitly for stream/backpressure comparisons.
Preserve the benchmark metric names before replacing any Python control-plane hot path with a Rust data-plane candidate.
comparison_profile.purpose: Separate stable report fields from run-specific timing and provenance before comparing Python/FastAPI and future Rust data-plane candidates.

execution_profile.database: fresh local SQLite database unless --database is provided
measured_paths: simulation write through the FastAPI control plane
execution_profile.purpose: Declare the local benchmark shape before comparing runtimes.
execution_profile.resource_scope: bounded local smoke, no worker fan-out

notes: This benchmark is intentionally small and local-resource safe.
It measures the current Python/FastAPI path to make future Rust migration evidence-driven.
Dropped events are measured as bounded replay rows missing from the local synthetic workload.

resource_guard.policy: bounded local smoke under the TelemForge automation resource guard
writes: optional JSON report when --output is provided
optional Markdown summary when --summary-output is provided

rust_data_plane_candidates: replay indexing and bounded replay queries
runtime_boundary.tracked_direction: Rust data plane direction, not a whole-project rewrite.
